label: Town of Wells
header:
# Town of Wells municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 25; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Town of Wells, Select Board page (wellsvermont.town): the current board is Don Preuss (Chair), Paul Woodruff, and Julie Cannata -- the page states Cannata 'replaces Tammy as select board member' (Holcomb, whose 2025-report term expired in 2026). The Secretary of State directory carries only a referral row for Wells

Town of Wells, 2025 Annual Report (posted on the town's Documents & Reports page), 'TOWN OFFICIALS' table: lists Nora Sargent as Clerk/Treasurer on a three-year term to 2028; the 2025 official ballot carried the clerk and treasurer as separate races, so the offices are modeled as two posts with one holder
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Nora Sargent as Wells's Town Clerk
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, town clerk contact spreadsheet (updated June 12, 2026): names Nora Sargent as Wells's Town Clerk
Town of Wells, 2025 Annual Report (posted on the town's Documents & Reports page), 'TOWN OFFICIALS' table: lists Nora Sargent as Clerk/Treasurer, three-year term to 2028
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Nora Sargent as Wells's Town Treasurer

Town of Wells, 2025 Annual Report (posted on the town's Documents & Reports page), 'TOWN OFFICIALS' table: lists Francis Gilman as Moderator on a one-year term expiring 2026. The seat stood at the March 2026 meeting and the outcome is unpublished -- straggler (Gilman is seated as a planning commissioner on the town's current page)

Town of Wells, 2025 Annual Report (posted on the town's Documents & Reports page), 'TOWN OFFICIALS' table: lists five trustees on five-year terms -- Amanda Butler (to 2030), Annie Constantinos (to 2029), Michael Lindley (to 2028), and Nancy Dauenhauer (to 2027); MaryBeth Harrison's seat expired in 2026, outcome unpublished -- straggler

Town of Wells, 2025 Annual Report (posted on the town's Documents & Reports page), 'TOWN OFFICIALS' table: fixes the commission at seven seats (one shown vacant). Wells elects its planning commissioners (24 V.S.A. sec. 4323; the 2025 official ballot carried planning commission races)

Town of Wells, Planning Commission page (wellsvermont.town): names the current members -- William Chmielewski, Cherry Hopson, Cheryl Woodruff, Heather Thomas, and Fran Gilman. Woodruff's and Chmielewski's report-listed terms expired in 2026, but the current page presents both as members. DIVERGENCE: Douglas Schlaefer (report term to 2027) is not on the current page -- straggler, not seated (disclosed on #163). Woodruff is also a Justice of the Peace; one record carries both

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists five Wells justices of the peace: Michelle Bates, William Steinmetz, Cheryl Woodruff, Jerry Stein, and Victoria Angis
Town of Wells, Justice of the Peace page (wellsvermont.town): concurs on the five names but misspells Angis as 'Angus' -- the certified form governs

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): certifies the five winners of Wells's November 5, 2024 justice of the peace election (vote for five): Michelle Bates, William Steinmetz, Cheryl Woodruff, Jerry Stein, and Victoria Angis. All five remain in office
